instruction: A cast-iron fire hydrant: a cylindrical barrel body on a flanged base, a domed bonnet cap on top with a pentagon operating nut, a large front pumper nozzle and two smaller side nozzles with caps and chains, and chipped paint revealing bare metal. Classic red.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a cast-iron fire hydrant. A cast-iron fire hydrant: a cylindrical barrel body on a flanged base, a domed bonnet cap on top with a pentagon operating nut, a large front pumper nozzle and two smaller side nozzles with caps and chains, and chipped paint revealing bare metal. Classic red. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
